meta.amac: Ekranda görünen tüm metinler: uyarı mesajı, 'Neden?' kanıt notu, öneri, EVA ve Dünya paneli. rules.py / comms.py / frontend metni buradan okur; uyarı metni koda sabit yazılmaz.
meta.bicim: Python str.format şablonları. Her {yer_tutucu} 'placeholders' bölümünde açıklanır. Eşik sayıları metne yazılmaz; ranges.json'dan doldurulur, böylece ekran ile motor hiçbir zaman çelişmez.
meta.sozlesme: docs/contract.json 0.1.0 (PR #26 ile 0.2.0). Seviye anahtarları Severity değerleridir (caution | warning | critical). Alert.message = alert_message_format; Alert.why[].note = why_note; mürettebat id'si crew-1..crew-4.
sozlesme_notlari: Sözleşmede ayrı 'recommendation' alanı yok; öneri alert_message_format ile mesajın sonuna eklenir. Ayrı alan istenirse contract PR'ı gerekir (Aydın).
Sözleşme 0.1.0'da pp_o2 birimi kPa; PR #26 (sözleşme 0.2.0) pp_o2 ve cabin_pressure'ı mmHg yapıyor ve Metric listesine pio2 ekliyor. Metinler mmHg kullanır.
CrewMember.activity (PR #26): resting ve sleep için why_note_rest, exercise için why_note_exercise, unknown için why_note_unknown kullanılır. Bilinmeyen etkinlik 'dinleniyor' sayılmaz.
radyasyon_etkisi.metric şimdilik radiation_dose_rate; PR #26 birleşirse olay kaynaklı uyarıda event_dose kullanılabilir (karar Aydın'da).
warning seviyesi için ayrı metin yok; rules.py warning üretirse critical metni kullanılır.
meta.dayanak: data/reference/ranges.json 1.2 (2026-11-14 19:30 donduruldu; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F kaynak denetimi aynı gün)

placeholders.name: Astronotun ekran adı (CrewMember.name)
placeholders.hr / hr_base / hr_rise: heart_rate şimdiki değer, kişisel baz çizgi, baz çizgiden artış (bpm)
placeholders.spo2 / spo2_base / spo2_drop: spo2 şimdiki değer, baz çizgi, düşüş (puan)
placeholders.rr / rr_base / rr_rise: resp_rate şimdiki değer, baz çizgi, artış (nefes/dk)
placeholders.temp / temp_base / temp_rise: core_temp şimdiki değer, baz çizgi, artış (°C)
placeholders.cum_mSv / event_mSv / projected_mSv: Kümülatif, olay ve olay sonu tahmini doz (simüle, mSv)
placeholders.pico2 / hours_allowed / hours_used / hou: EVA giysi değerleri (P2); hours_allowed ranges.giysi.pico2_limitleri kademesinden
placeholders.demo_seconds / seconds_left: ranges.iletisim.demo_gecikme (20 sn) ve varışa kalan saniye
placeholders.profile_name / profile_source / co2_limi: Aktif profil adı, limit kaynağı, limit metni (örn. '1.0% (7.6 mmHg)')

global.no_data_note: No valid {sensor} reading for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings. Missing data is never treated as normal. Check sensor placement.
global.countdown_o2: O₂ to lower limit: {o2_hours} h (sim time)
global.countdown_unlimited_note: Removal/production capacity is higher than crew use, so the level is not moving toward the limit.

source_status.doğrulanmadı: assumption (demo parameter, not a medical threshold)

global.exercise_note: {name} is exercising: a higher heart rate is expected and is not counted as cardiac load.

olasi_hipoksi.title: Possible hypoxia sign
olasi_hipoksi._not: ranges.json #21 egzersiz istisnası: activity resting veya sleep ise why_note_rest, exercise ise why_note_exercise, unknown ise why_note_unknown. Egzersizde ve etkinlik bilinmezken nabız/solunum artışı kanıt olarak yazılmaz.
olasi_hipoksi.why_note_rest: SpO₂ {spo2}% is {spo2_drop} points below {name}'s baseline {spo2_base}%, with HR +{hr_rise} bpm and/or breathing +{rr_rise}/min, for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings. Cabin PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg is below the {pio2_target_min}–{pio2_target_max} mmHg normoxia target. Body and cabin point the same way.
olasi_hipoksi.why_note_exercise: SpO₂ {spo2}% is {spo2_drop} points below {name}'s baseline {spo2_base}% for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings, while cabin PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg is below the {pio2_target_min}–{pio2_target_max} mmHg normoxia target. {name} is exercising, so O₂ use is highest and symptoms appear first in this crew member. Heart rate and breathing rise during exercise are expected and are not used as evidence.
olasi_hipoksi.why_note_unknown: SpO₂ {spo2}% is {spo2_drop} points below {name}'s baseline {spo2_base}% for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings, while cabin PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg is below the {pio2_target_min}–{pio2_target_max} mmHg normoxia target. {name}'s current activity is unknown, so heart rate and breathing are not used as evidence.

recommendation.caution: Reduce activity, check the O₂ source and cabin PIO₂, prepare backup O₂
recommendation.critical: Stop exercise now, check the O₂ source and cabin PIO₂, switch to backup O₂

sources.ref: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F, [V2 6003], Table 6.2-1 (normoxia range)

olasi_co2_etkisi.title: Possible CO₂ effect
olasi_co2_etkisi.why_note: Cabin ppCO₂ {ppco2} mmHg is above the {co2_yellow} mmHg watch level (limit {co2_limit} mmHg), and {name}'s breathing is {rr}/min (+{rr_rise} over baseline) for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings. NASA reports headaches at 2.8–4.5 mmHg; fatigue, lethargy and nausea above 4.5 mmHg.

recommendation.caution: Reduce effort, increase CO₂ removal, monitor until ppCO₂ is below {co2_limit} mmHg
recommendation.critical: Stop exercise, increase CO₂ removal, monitor until ppCO₂ is below {co2_limit} mmHg

isi_sapmasi.title: Temperature deviation
isi_sapmasi.why_note: Temperature {temp} °C is +{temp_rise} °C above {name}'s baseline {temp_base} °C for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings (watch +{watch_thr} °C, action +{action_thr} °C). Several causes are possible (e.g. infection or heat stress); the system does not diagnose.

recommendation.caution: Monitor, rest and take an extra measurement
recommendation.critical: Rest, report to Earth and request extra measurements to tell infection from heat stress (not a diagnosis)

kalp_yuku.title: Cardiac load

message.critical: {name}: resting heart rate high – reduce load

kalp_yuku.why_note: {name} is at rest, but heart rate {hr} bpm is +{hr_rise} over baseline {hr_base} bpm for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings (watch +{watch_thr}, action +{action_thr}). This rule only runs at rest; a higher heart rate during exercise is expected and is not flagged.

recommendation.critical: Reduce effort, monitor and report to Earth

radyasyon_etkisi.title: Radiation exposure

message.caution: {name}: projected solar storm dose approaching threshold

radyasyon_etkisi.why_note_event: Solar particle event ({event_type}, {event_time}, NASA DONKI). {name}'s projected dose by event end is {projected_mSv} mSv (event dose so far {event_mSv} mSv), reaching {yellow_ratio}×{spe_threshold} mSv. The warning comes before the dose is received. Dose is simulated.
radyasyon_etkisi.why_note_career: {name}'s cumulative dose {cum_mSv} mSv is at or above {yellow_ratio}× the {career_limit} mSv career limit. Dose is simulated.
radyasyon_etkisi.threshold_label: 250 mSv: NASA design requirement, used here as an alert threshold (not an astronaut limit)
radyasyon_etkisi.career_label: 600 mSv: NASA career limit for each astronaut

recommendation.caution: Prepare to move to the storm shelter and follow the dose bar
recommendation.critical: Move to the storm shelter now; after the event, log each person's dose and report to Earth

sources.ref: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1, [V1 4031] (250 mSv SPE design requirement)
NASA DONKI (event time and type; not dose)
varsayım: dose model, 1.8 mSv/day base (MSL RAD, Zeitlin et al. 2013) + simulated event

cabin_alerts._not: Anahtarlar ranges.json 'kurallar' listesindeki rule id'leridir. Listede olmayanlar (basınç, O2 arızası) rules.py kendi id'siyle kullanır.

ppco2-caution.why_note: ppCO₂ is above {co2_yellow} mmHg for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings. NASA keeps the 7-day average below 2.5 mmHg to hold headache risk under 1%. Limit is {co2_limit} mmHg (1-hour average).
ppco2-caution.recommendation: Check CO₂ removal and avoid heavy exercise

ppco2-limit.why_note: ppCO₂ is above the {co2_limit} mmHg cabin limit for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings.
ppco2-limit.recommendation: Increase CO₂ removal now and stop exercise until ppCO₂ is below {co2_limit} mmHg

pio2-normoxia-low.message: Cabin O₂ below normoxia: PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg
pio2-normoxia-low.why_note: PIO₂ is below the {pio2_target_min}–{pio2_target_max} mmHg normoxia target for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings. PIO₂ = (PB − 47) × FIO₂.
pio2-normoxia-low.recommendation: Check O₂ generation and prepare backup O₂

pio2-hypoxia-low.message: Cabin O₂ below mild-hypoxia limit: PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg
pio2-hypoxia-low.why_note: PIO₂ is below {pio2_mild_min} mmHg (mild hypoxia lower limit, 1-hour average). It must never go below {pio2_abs_min} mmHg.
pio2-hypoxia-low.recommendation: Switch to backup O₂ now and stop exercise for all crew

sources.ref: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F, Table 6.2-1 and footnote

pio2-normoxia-high.message: Cabin O₂ above normoxia: PIO₂ {pio2} mmHg
pio2-normoxia-high.why_note: PIO₂ is above the {pio2_target_max} mmHg normoxia target for {n_consecutive} consecutive readings.

pressure-out-of-range.message: Total pressure out of range: {pressure} mmHg
pressure-out-of-range.why_note: Continuous exposure requires {pressure_min} < pressure ≤ {pressure_max} mmHg (5 < psia ≤ 15.0).
pressure-out-of-range.recommendation: Check for leaks and the pressure control system

o2-generation-failure.why_note: O₂ production is 0. Only the O₂ countdown speeds up; CO₂ removal is unaffected, so the CO₂ countdown does not change.
o2-generation-failure.recommendation: Switch to backup O₂ and reduce crew activity to lower O₂ use

eva_suit._not: P2. Giysi PICO2 için Tablo 11.3-1 kullanılır, 3 mmHg kabin limiti DEĞİL.
eva_suit.pico2_ok: Suit CO₂ {pico2} mmHg: no time limit.
eva_suit.pico2_timed: Suit CO₂ {pico2} mmHg: max {hours_allowed} h per day at this level ({hours_used} h used).
eva_suit.pico2_red: Suit CO₂ above 15 mmHg: return to airlock now.
eva_suit._not_suit_time: Rev E'deki 'giyside en çok 14 saat' cümlesi Rev F'te yok; ekranda NASA limiti olarak gösterilmez (ranges.json: kısmen).
eva_suit.return_airlock: Return to the airlock. {minutes} min of suit supply left (sim time).

sources.ref: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F, Section 11.3 (suit CO₂ time limits)

comms._not: Dünya paneli (P3). CommsMessage.sender değerleri crew | mission_control | system. 'statuses' adları öneridir; Barış'ın comms.py şartnamesindeki adlar geçerlidir.
comms.delay_label: One-way delay: {minutes} min (demo: {demo_seconds} s represents {minutes} min)
comms.delay_info: Mars–Earth one-way delay is 3–22 min, round trip up to ~45 min. The crew cannot wait for an answer in an emergency, so the system recommends action first and reports second.

outgoing_templates.cabin_report: CABIN REPORT {sim_time} – {message}. Countdown O₂ {o2_hours} h / CO₂ {co2_hours} h.
outgoing_templates.radiation_report: RADIATION REPORT {sim_time} – Crew in storm shelter. Event dose (simulated): crew-1 {d1} / crew-2 {d2} / crew-3 {d3} / crew-4 {d4} mSv.
outgoing_templates.status_ok: STATUS {sim_time} – All crew Normal. No active alerts.

incoming_replies.health_report: Report received for {name}. Agree with action. Keep monitoring and send vitals every 10 min.
incoming_replies.cabin_report: Cabin report received. Continue on backup system; repair procedure follows.
incoming_replies.radiation_report: Dose log received. Stay in shelter until event end; we will confirm all-clear.

comms.reply_note: Replies are pre-written demo messages, not real Mission Control.

profiles.denizalti_note: 0.8% CO₂ is a 2018 study recommendation for 90-day exposure, not an official Navy limit. Crew metabolic rates are astronaut averages (assumption).
profiles.yeralti_siginagi_note: US coal mine refuge chamber (30 CFR 7.506). CO and methane are not modeled.
profiles.pitch_line: The system built to protect astronauts works the same way in submarines and underground refuge chambers.
